title: Power Streamers and Premium Opportunity
context: Power Streamers are the most engaged illustrative persona.
question: Should Spotify test a persona-specific Premium message?
evidence: High listening minutes, frequent sessions and high ad skipping.
observation: This persona uses the product heavily and skips many advertisements.
insight: The persona receives strong product value but may experience advertisement friction.
action_hypothesis: Test Premium messaging focused on uninterrupted, ad-free listening.
guardrail_kpis: Churn, complaints and retained Premium status.
limitation: High engagement does not guarantee willingness to pay.
